theorems.statement: ∀ (P m l : ℕ) (pL : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid m) (U : Set (Euclid m)) (F : Set (Euclid P)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P l) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn U l), IsOpen U → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) l, |ξ x β| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm β) → (∀ γ : Covector (Euclid m) l, covectorEuclideanNorm (γ.compContinuousLinearMap pL) ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm γ) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U l, Y ω = ∫ x in F, ξ x (((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid m) l) (pL x)).compContinuousLinearMap pL) ∂μ) → Y.massOn U ≤ μ (F ∩ pL ⁻¹' U)
